---
title: "Preparing your data"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
```

The analyses of the package take the same objects: a community matrix, a tree, a table of
predictors and, for some of them, coordinates and areas. This article goes from tables like
those of a field survey to a first test. The data below are simulated, to keep the article
self-contained.

```{r}
library(comdynamite)

set.seed(1)
tree <- treeshapesim::sim_tree_shape(10)
tree$tip.label <- paste0("Genus_species", 1:10)
sites <- expand.grid(x = 1:8, y = 1:5)
sites$site <- paste0("s", seq_len(nrow(sites)))
sites$depth <- sites$x * 10 + rnorm(nrow(sites), sd = 5)
sites$habitat <- rep(c("forest", "open"), length.out = nrow(sites))
traits <- species_traits(tree, lambda = 1, optima_range = c(0, 90), rmax_range = c(0, 30))
wide <- simulate_static(traits, sites$depth, incidence = TRUE)$abundance
records <- data.frame(site = sites$site[row(wide)[wide > 0]],
                      species = sub("_", " ", tree$tip.label[col(wide)[wide > 0]]))
head(records)
```

## The community matrix

`comm` has one row per site and one column per species, with numbers only, so names of sites
go to the row names. A table of records becomes a matrix with `table()`.

```{r}
comm <- records |>
  with(table(site, species)) |>
  unclass()
comm[1:3, 1:3]
```

A site without records does not appear in this matrix. `pcc_test()`, `phylo_beta_test()` and
`phylo_beta()` need at least one individual in every site, so sites without any species stay
out of those analyses.

## The tree

Species are matched to the tips by name, in any order. The most frequent problem is the
spelling of names, as here, where the table has spaces and the tree has underscores.

```{r}
setdiff(colnames(comm), tree$tip.label)[1:3]
colnames(comm) <- gsub(" ", "_", colnames(comm))
setdiff(colnames(comm), tree$tip.label)
```

Species in only one of the two are dropped with a warning that names them, so read these
warnings before reading results. Analyses that use distances among species need branch
lengths, whereas `node_contrasts()` also works with a topology.

## Predictors

`env` has one row per site and numeric columns. Factors become dummy variables with
`model.matrix()`, without the intercept column. Missing values are not accepted, so sites
without data need to leave `comm` and `env` together.

```{r}
rownames(sites) <- sites$site
sites <- sites[rownames(comm), ]
env <- cbind(depth = sites$depth, open = model.matrix(~ habitat, sites)[, "habitatopen"])
rownames(env) <- rownames(comm)
head(env, 3)
```

When `comm` and the other tables all have row names, sites are matched by name. Otherwise
they are matched by position, and the rows need to be in the same order.

## Areas and coordinates

For historical hypotheses, `biogeography_matrix()` builds the events of `node_test()` from
the area of each site, with `NA` for sites outside all areas. Polygons give the area with
`sf::st_join()`. Events should come from a hypothesis stated in advance.

```{r}
area <- ifelse(sites$x <= 3, "west", ifelse(sites$x >= 6, "east", NA))
names(area) <- rownames(comm)
events <- biogeography_matrix(area, list(barrier = list("west", "east")))
table(events)
```

Sites of an area are usually neighbours, and free permutations then reject too often.
`patch_permutations()` gives a null model for landscapes with edges. Coordinates should be
projected, because distances are Euclidean; `sf::st_transform()` does this.

```{r}
coords <- as.matrix(sites[, c("x", "y")])
area_moves <- patch_permutations(coords, events, n_perm = 99)
```

## A first test

```{r}
nodes <- node_contrasts(tree)
out <- node_test(comm, nodes, env, events, n_perm = 99, area_permutations = area_moves)
out
```

The number of permutations here keeps the article fast. Use more than this in an analysis,
because the smallest possible p-value depends on it and it is printed with the results.

## What each analysis needs

| Function | `comm` | Tree | Predictors | Other |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node_test()` | sites by species | contrasts from `node_contrasts()` | `env` | `biogeography`, optional |
| `pcc_test()` | no empty sites | with branch lengths | `env` | |
| `phylo_beta_test()` | no empty sites | with branch lengths | `env` | |
| `phylo_vector()` | sites by species | with branch lengths | one predictor | |
| `trait_partition()` | sites by species | traits or `phylo_vector()` scores | `env` | `space` |
